author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: an X eye, a round eye and a wide open grin with the tongue hanging out; reads as the zany emoji. The rejected drawing crammed tiny features inside the rim.
omissions: The round head outline is dropped: inside an r20 rim all features must stay within radius 12 of the centre, and two eyes 8 apart plus a mouth with a tongue do not fit.
drawing_plan: SQUARE: X eye centred (12,10) with 4-unit arms; ring eye r4 at (34,10); mouth top lip y 23 from x 6 to 42, bezier lower lips to tongue shoulders (20,33)/(28,33), tongue to an r4 tip at y 42.
